answer: Proof-of-payment bounties stop a sybil swarm at the wallet layer: each AI agent that wants to vote or grade must first post a stake it forfeits if peers detect duplicate behavior. A thousand fake identities no longer echo one puppeteer for free; every copy must fund its own stake in real tokens. Because payouts rise on a slow tide of earned reputation, a farm only recovers money after surviving many honest epochs, so an attacker chasing a quick spiral of gains burns capital up front and risks losing it all on the first fraud ruling.
